messages:
maria-support: @sam-ml heads-up — customer reports different assistant outputs after the rollout last night, thinks chat template delim handling changed. attaching repro.
ella-customer: see below. before rollout the assistant returned a step-by-step recipe. after rollout it returns a short refusal. same API call and model.
ella-customer: CURL we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_test' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "model":"rwd-13b",
    "input": "<SYSTEM>\u00A0\nYou are ChefBot.\n</SYSTEM>\n<USER> How do I bake sourdough?",
    "chat_template":"chat_template_v2"
  }'
```
ella-customer: request id r-0a1b2c3-ll
ella-customer: expected: starts with "Sure — here’s a step-by-step sourdough recipe..."\nactual: "I can't help with that." (short, unhelpful)
maria-support: thanks. can you paste the exact raw input bytes? any non-ascii spaces / zero-width chars?
ella-customer: copying — looks normal but there *is* a soft NBSP between SYSTEM and newline (copied from a doc): `"<SYSTEM>\u00A0\nYou are ChefBot."`
sam-ml: thanks, that's a likely smoking gun. we rolled a tokenizer/normalization tweak last night that canonicalizes whitespace and removes some zero-widths when chat_template_v2 is used.
sam-ml: deploy-bot shows rollout completed at 1954301000 for chat_template_v2 change.
deploy-bot: deploy chat-template/whitespace-normalize to prod at 1954301000 — version chat_template_v2+norm
josh-platform: confirming — change was intended to fix leading/trailing NBSPs causing bloated token counts. we didn't expect it to change role delimiter parsing, but the template parser folds consecutive separators now which could cause the system role to be swallowed when NBSP present.
sam-ml: can you repro locally with the customer's raw input? I'll try to reproduce tokenization differences and diff tokens.
maria-support: repro script (customer payload with NBSP):
```
python repro.py --model rwd-13b --template chat_template_v2 --input "<SYSTEM>\u00A0\nYou are ChefBot.\n</SYSTEM>\n<USER> How do I bake sourdough?"
```
sam-ml: running... got different tokenization sets between pre-change and post-change kernels. pre-change tokens: ["<SYSTEM>", "\n", "You", "are", ...]. post-change tokens collapsed: ["<SYSTEM> You", "are", ...] -> system role token merged into user content, so model now sees role text in user span and triggers safety/refusal.
ella-customer: that explains it. we had a few templates autogenerated from Google Docs that inserted NBSPs.
maria-support: short-term mitigation: customer can pad with explicit newline delimiter or switch to chat_template_v1 which still preserves original spacing. try adding an explicit `\n---\n` between roles.
ella-customer: switching to v1 worked for us. thanks.
sam-ml: medium-term: we'll add a compat flag to opt out of whitespace normalization per-request: `?normalize_whitespace=false` and do a tiny patch to not merge delimiters when NBSPs are present. putting as P1 since customers are hitting generation regressions.
josh-platform: assigned to @sam-ml and @eng-runtime for a patch + canary. also scheduling a rollback path if we see >1% regression rate on chat routes in next 12h.
maria-support: logging action items: 1) reproduce token delta and attach to ticket 4821; 2) add compat flag and feature-gate; 3) notify customers using chat_template_v2 of potential whitespace normalization impact; 4) roll canary and monitor.
sam-ml: attaching token diffs and a short script in the ticket.
maria-support: +1. @ella-customer — leaving this thread open until the compat flag is live. sorry for the break :disappointed:.
ella-customer: appreciate the fast response. ping me when flag is available :pray:.
josh-platform: moving to incident status: Escalation -> Owner sam-ml. I'll create a canary job and watch latency/error signals. :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary deployed chat-template/compat-flag at 1954312000 to 5% of traffic
maria-support: closing note for thread: workaround confirmed (v1 template or explicit delimiter). patch and canary in flight. will follow up in ticket 4821 when fixed.
